name: budget-reporting-monorepo
description: Budget Reporting – monorepo with Vue 3, Svelte 5 and Express API

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,vue,svelte -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:vue" "npm run dev:svelte"
scripts.test:all: cross-env BENCH_SEED=run-42 npm --prefix tests run test:all:csv
scripts.bench:benchmark: cd tests && npx tsx run-benchmarks.ts benchmark 10
scripts.bench:chart: cd tests && npx tsx run-benchmarks.ts chart 10
scripts.bench:build: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench build 10
scripts.bench:10: cd tests && npx tsx run-benchmarks.ts all 10
scripts.docker:bench:enterprise: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench enterprise 10
scripts.docker:bench:cellmatrix: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench cellmatrix 10
scripts.docker:bench:colscale: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench colscale 10
scripts.docker:bench:celltypes: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench celltypes 5
scripts.docker:bench:rowinsert: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench rowinsert 10
scripts.docker:bench:gridops: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench gridops 10
scripts.docker:bench:memory: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench memory 10
scripts.docker:bench:heap-suites: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench benchmark,colscale,celltypes,rowinsert 10
scripts.docker:bench:quick: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench all 5
scripts.docker:lighthouse: docker compose build && docker compose run --rm bench lighthouse
scripts.install:all: cd services/backend-api && npm install && cd ../../apps/frontend-vue && npm install && cd ../frontend-svelte-plain && npm install && cd ../../tests && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
